decisions.reason: The optical spectrum service builds on the firm's owned fibre and moved to the home page in 2019, so it meets aspirations in line with the firm's high-bandwidth strategic direction, and the firm's expansion gives it slack to keep it despite falling industry turnover.

The voice number ordering portal is a low-cost software support tool that serves the established voice business and fits the move to real-time provisioning, so there is no clear shortfall that would trigger problemistic search, even though its modest visibility and the trimming of other voice products create some risk.
